## Customer Story

**Customer:** Cox Automotive — Leading automotive services company

**Challenge:** Diverse AI needs across multiple business lines — from dealer tools to consumer experiences — requiring different agent patterns

**Solution:** Large-scale deployment of 17 AI-powered solutions across the automotive marketplace, leveraging multiple agent patterns for different use cases including conversational, event-driven, and platform approaches.
